title: CommutativeSum's operand order is swapped
synthetic_rationale: Exercises the runner's equivalent-reviewed path: a mutation that survives AND has an audited equivalence review, so the runner must reclassify it away from a bare survivor. Not a per-head query mutation.

equivalence_review.rationale: a+b and b+a are byte-for-byte identical under Go's two's-complement int addition for every pair of inputs: addition is commutative and neither operand order can overflow differently. No test can distinguish them because there is nothing to distinguish. Hand-verified against Go's spec (arithmetic operators), not merely asserted.

notes: The review is about this record's one patch: transformation.pre_image_fingerprint pins the patch's region, so if that region of arith.go changes the record is invalid-transform until the patch is re-authored and re-pinned (`just semantic-mutant-repin`) — the review is never applied to a mutation other than the one it reviewed.
